name: lazypowers
description: Instruction-only product-to-delivery orchestration over official Superpowers with transcript-first callbacks, exact Git verification, and absence-aware target verification

interface.longDescription: An instruction-only Product workflow over official Superpowers. It keeps Product chat available while isolated task chats execute approved work, reconciles transcript-first callbacks, verifies exact Git delivery, and uses project-owned probes for absence-aware initial target verification without supplying an external-action adapter.
defaultPrompt: Use $lazypowers:product to turn an approved Product spec into absence-aware, verified delivery.
